policy.build_gated: Reserved for an active required workflow that configures and compiles the profile on every change; no profile currently has this level in this fork.
policy.smoke_gated: Reserved for an active build gate plus a named automated process route; archived workflow definitions are not executed evidence.
policy.source_capable: The live BuildTools registry exposes a target. This fork has no active required CI gate; a target declaration proves neither a completed build nor runtime acceptance.
policy.not_in_public_matrix: No supported validation target is published for this application/platform combination.
